name: Construction-Computing Education Map
description: Dataset of higher-education institutions offering programmes in digital construction, BIM, and construction informatics, with programme, cost, accreditation, delivery, and geographic detail. 1159 institutions in 80 countries: Europe (364), North America (341), South America (299), Western Asia (89), Oceania (42), Central America (21), Caribbean (3).
citation: Construction-Computing Education Map (v1.3.0). CC BY 4.0. <add author / DOI on deposit>.

sourcesOfRecord.note: Primary per-record sources are the institution homepage (`website`) and the programme pages (`programLinks`). No third-party aggregator is treated as authoritative.

coordinates.method: Geocoded with OpenStreetMap Nominatim, then a precision-audit pass that re-queried city-centroid fallbacks with a 25 km distance gate, plus manual verification of unresolved cases. Per-record method recorded in `geoSource`.

graduatesPerYear.nature: Values are annual-graduate estimates, expressed as ranges. They are indicative, not official institutional statistics.
graduatesPerYear.imputation: Records originally lacking a figure were imputed from the median of peer institutions in this dataset (same country and institution type where n>=3, widening to type, then to all). Imputed records carry `graduatesEstimated: true`.
graduatesPerYear.note2026-10: 842 records carry 'Not published' (no intake or graduate figure on the programme page); the rest carry ranges, either collected, peer-imputed, or derived from published intake caps.

cost.unit: indicative tuition in each record's costCurrency (local currency; per year unless the record states otherwise in its sources).
cost.note: Ranges run from the lowest to the highest published yearly fee (e.g. home to international, or across the record's programmes), taken from the institution's own pages or, where the institution publishes none, an official national source (e.g. Türkiye's ÖSYM programme guide, Oman's Ministry of Higher Education guide). Per-credit or whole-programme fees are converted to a yearly figure (standard full-time load, or total divided by stated duration). '0' = no tuition charged (e.g. state-university places for citizens, funded places). '-' = fee not published.

legend.1: recently collected, not yet validated against sources
legend.2: cross-referenced with publicly available university sources

topics.note: The topics field uses a controlled vocabulary split into two facets: computingTopics (the digital subject matter) and domains (built-environment context). Each record carries computingTopics and domains as derived subsets of topics.

tagging.rule: Tag a topic only where the institution's own pages show a named course/module or an explicit programme learning outcome; applied uniformly to all institutions. CAD, programming, GIS or 3D visualisation on their own do not qualify a record.
tagging.interpretation: Tags are confirmed curriculum presence (a floor), not an exhaustive measure; absence = not confirmed from public sources. Documentation bias is a stated limitation.

provenanceFields.lastChecked: ISO date a record's programme/fee data was last verified against source; null = not yet verified in this provenance system

knownLimitations: 590 institutions are pinned to a city/state-capital location rather than the exact campus (geoSource 'nominatim:city', 'manual:city', 'manual:state capital', 'manual:regional capital').
842 graduatesPerYear values are 'Not published'; all graduate figures are indicative, not official statistics.
118 cost values are '-' because the institution does not publish the fee (enquiry-gated, apprenticeship-funded, calculator-only, or price on request).
'0' cost conflates fully free tuition with tuition-free programmes that still charge semester/administrative contributions.
Cost figures are current-year rates and will drift; re-verify against source before citing.

Coverage gaps: Africa, South/East/South-East Asia, Iran and Central Asia have not yet been swept; Central America and the Caribbean are partial. Azerbaijan, Lebanon, Israel and Kuwait were re-swept only partially; in Türkiye and Yemen, institutions whose catalogues were unreachable are not yet confirmed either way (see reviewed_institutions.csv).

validation.method: Stratified random sample (seed=42, region-stratified), each institution checked against its own programme pages under tagging-rubric.md.
validation.censusStatus: In progress (38/309 verified). Sample rate (>50% under-tagged) warrants full verification; CESI campuses corrected via shared national-programme evidence. Priority: <=2-tag population.
